qualification_policy.height_semantics: OSM height is absolute top above ground; eave=height-roof_height; base=max(0,min_height)
qualification_policy.height_arithmetic: Require roof_height <= height-base without epsilon inflation; preserve all numeric source values. Negative source min_height would clamp base to zero; no accepted record has a negative min_height.
qualification_policy.geometry: Keep exact cached polygon; no repairs, clipping, simplification, holes, multipart geometry, or MRR substitution.
qualification_policy.direction: Use exact-version OSM roof:direction downslope bearing; East/South unit=[sin(theta),-cos(theta)].
qualification_policy.orientation: Explicit exact-version OSM along/across only; along ridge follows long MRR axis, across follows short MRR axis.
qualification_policy.has_parts_parent: Reject whole parents with parts, including restored residual parents.
qualification_policy.historical_geometry_limit: Historical way tags are checked. Way node IDs alone do not verify historical node coordinates; footprints remain the cached Overture geometry.

partition_policy: Replay original median-split tree; retain every current output ID. Fail rather than silently split or omit accepted roofs.
